verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Fedora Workstation ships an app store experience (GNOME Software) allowing install from Fedora repos/Flathub with a click, implying a browsable catalog, but there is no mention of category-based browsing or filtering specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of category/filter UI in the software center, screenshots or community confirmation of catalog browsing by category, and independent verification of ease of finding familiar apps as a switcher.
